---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

Follow the nearest `AGENTS.md` when editing Markdown.

For files under `docs/`, preserve policy structure and cross-links, and do not silently rewrite governance or workflow rules to match runtime behavior unless the task explicitly asks for policy alignment.

For `README.md`, keep onboarding information practical and command-oriented.

When you notice drift between prose docs and executable config such as hooks or workflows, call out the drift explicitly instead of "fixing" it opportunistically.
